title: Jarvis-Matrix Registry
description: Schema for the auto-generated skill/agent registry used by the Jarvis router.

version.description: Registry schema version (1 for develop-only, 2 for develop + design, 3 for develop + design + copywriting)

plugins_root.description: Absolute path to the develop github-plugins directory

design_plugins_root.description: Absolute path to the design github-plugins directory

copywriting_plugins_root.description: Absolute path to the copywriting github-plugins directory

last_indexed.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last registry build

plugins.description: Map of develop plugin-id to plugin metadata

design_plugins.description: Map of design plugin-id to plugin metadata

copywriting_plugins.description: Map of copywriting plugin-id to plugin metadata

path.description: Relative path from plugins root to this plugin directory

version.description: Plugin version from plugin.json if available

levels.description: Named modes or levels (e.g. ponytail lite/full/ultra)

invocation.description: How to invoke this plugin (e.g. embedded-mode)

path.description: Relative path from plugins root to SKILL.md

dir.description: Output directory relative to project root

format.description: Primary output file name or format
